description.html: This 120x40x40 cm aquarium with 192 liters of volume offers serious space for creating an underwater biotope. A larger volume means more stable water parameters and the option to keep larger fish species.

The space allows you to keep larger species such as angelfish and discus, or a community with several schools of smaller fish. More stable water parameters in a larger volume mean less stress for the fish and less frequent intervention.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
